messages:
Sam (AE): hey team — ACME is ready to sign but they pushed back on a few DPA redlines and want a specific e-sign routing: procurement signs first, then legal. Can we get this over the line today? I uploaded the order form to the shared folder: https://confluence.internal/acme/orderform
Priya (SE): quick q: is pricing final or do we need to clarify burst/overage? also is the POC credit applied to this order form or separate?
Jordan (Legal): flagging the main DPA asks: stronger deletion language, subprocessors list, audit rights, and they asked to carve out security review cadence. If we don't have their marked-up DPA, propose these minimal changes:
```
1) Data deletion: Redwood will remove Customer Data within 30 days of termination unless retention required by law.
2) Subprocessors: Redwood will maintain an up-to-date subprocessor list and notify 30 days before changes.
3) Audit: Security audit rights limited to annually with reasonable notice and SSO access to logs.
```
Jordan (Legal): also SLA — they asked for 99.99%. We should offer 99.9 + escalation path and credit schedule. I'll draft a one-paragraph fallback.
Marta (Finance): billing questions: do they want NET30 or NET45? need PO number and billing contact. Also confirm if they require invoice to be sent to a procurement mailbox or to the project owner. If ACH required, we need W-9 + bank remit.
Alex (Sales Ops): can we add these fields to the order form template? Minimal change: `billing_contact`, `po_number`, `net_terms`, `invoice_email`.
Priya (SE): for e-sign: customer wants procurement -> legal sequential signing. DocuSign supports routing. They also asked whether the MSA must be countersigned first or if order form signed alone is acceptable. Customer prefers MSA countersigned, but can accept order form if MSA is in doc history.
Sam (AE): I asked the customer: getting signer emails and PO number now. They said procurement@acme.com and legal@acme.com for signers, procurement insists on sequential sig order.
Jordan (Legal): sequential is fine. Please confirm procurement email is a monitored mailbox (not a ticketing alias). For DPA redlines: if they send marked-up DPA, we'll track changes in Google Docs; otherwise I'll produce a negotiated summary for them to acknowledge.
Marta (Finance): FYI - if they require NET45 we'll need CSM signoff for credit exposure. Also check tax jurisdiction for EMEA.
Priya (SE): POC note — the POC credit has already been provisioned and will apply on first invoice, so no change to pricing required on the order form. I'll add a comment on the order form about the credit.
Alex (Sales Ops): snippet to add to template:
```
Order form fields to include:
- billing_contact: name + email
- po_number: string
- net_terms: NET30/NET45
- invoice_email: billing@customer.com
```
Sam (AE): plan: Jordan drafts minimal DPA/SLA language by EOD, Marta confirms payment terms, Alex updates template, Priya annotates POC credit. I'll collect signer emails and send to docusign once we have the final order form.
(docusign-bot): Envelope 0x7f9a sent to procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com — status: sent (sequential).
Sam (AE): Sent. Procurement asked for procurement-first, legal-second. Routing set to sequential.
Jordan (Legal): set routing and added the SLA paragraph + inserted the deletion/subprocessor language. Pushed changes to the shared doc: https://docs.internal/legal/acme-dpa-draft
Marta (Finance): received PO# ACME-8452 and confirms NET30. Finance ready to invoice.
Sam (AE): great — closing action: I will update the order form with PO and push envelope. Will post final copy here when signed. Thanks! :rocket:
Jordan (Legal): LGTM. :white_check_mark:
